text: Renee Castellano, Pinehurst's Regional Inventory Manager, reports several stores' depletion numbers haven't moved in days -- even though those stores are still selling. Monitoring didn't catch it. This is that bug hunt.
Three checkpoints, in order: COPY_HISTORY shows Snowpipe loading clean files every few minutes, so ingestion is cleared. The Stream has data -- about 438,000 pending rows spanning five days.
That backlog points at one object. SHOW TASKS reveals it: the Task merging the Stream into the clean table is SUSPENDED, with no error anywhere, because a suspended Task just doesn't run.
Snowpipe and the Stream are both proven healthy. Not yet proven: exactly when the Task stopped, and who or what suspended it.
Next: pin the timeline, resume the Task, clear the backlog, and build the check that would have caught this in minutes.
